acceptance_criteria.description: Countersigned PilotExternalApproval, candidate/APK identity, zero-WS budgets (0 initial, 0 reconnect), <= 15s HTTP timeout, and <= 15m monotonic deadline required for gate activation.
Volatile-only authorization, OFFLINE_DEFAULT boot, offline APK live activation rejected, UI-checkbox-only rejected, and mock authorizations rejected on live gateways.

requirements.title: Human-Operated In-Memory Credential Entry & Screen Protection

acceptance_criteria.description: FLAG_SECURE enforced on sensitive credential entry window.
No rememberSaveable, persistent state, logs, or exports retain passwords; mutable CharArray buffers wiped on submit/serialization/cancel/failure/exit/teardown.

requirements.title: Evidence-Grounded Wire Login Envelope & Parameter Validation

acceptance_criteria.description: Login payload matches reconciled 6.1.7 wire schema (api_version=6.1.7, app_name=WeBack, client_id=yugong_app, language=en, opt=login).
PilotHttpOperationGuard rejects extra/duplicate/wrong-type JSON fields and unknown operations fail-closed.

requirements.title: Single Login Budget, Anti-Retry & Challenge Fail-Closed Boundary

acceptance_criteria.description: At most ONE login attempt per authorization run, <= 15s HTTP timeout, 0 requests on account/region mismatch, 0 automatic retries, and 0 passwordless refresh.
Zero MD5 fallback, zero speculative envelope retry, zero CAPTCHA automation; aborts fail-closed on challenge indicators.

requirements.title: Trusted Authentication Origin & Conservative Dynamic-Origin Quarantine

acceptance_criteria.description: Requests routed strictly to approved region /prod/oauth endpoint over TLS without redirects or proxy.
Unapproved dynamic origins retain only sanitized observation, discard session/token, revoke auth and clean up without auto-retry or resumable quarantined tokens.

requirements.title: Single Read-Only Inventory Query & Exact Target Robot Validation

acceptance_criteria.description: At most ONE user_thing_list_get request when origins pre-approved; 0 WS initial connections, 0 reconnects, 0 outbound WS frames, 0 robot commands, and selectAndObserveDevice never called.
Exact target validation separated from telemetry; exposes minimum authorized target data only; missing/mismatched/unsupported/malformed target terminates safely.

requirements.title: Minimal Live Pilot UI Integration, Monotonic Expiry & Pre-Live Device Readiness

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot-only 11-step live UI flow wired in MainActivity preserving mock workflow in both APKs, verified by Activity-level Compose integration tests.

Monotonic deadline expiry and generation-fenced teardown verified on JVM; FCT-004B physical-device expiry NOT_RUN limitation recorded and mandatory offline physical-device monotonic expiry added to pre-live checklist.
